name: guard-hpcc-homa-ring-drain-window
purpose: Give the frozen 2 ms alternating ring trace enough drain time for every protocol without changing its arrivals.
selection_policy: Reuse the exact frozen seed-1 flow SHA. Try run windows in listed order and select the first at which all 480 Homa messages complete. Do not inspect FCT, queue, or protocol ranking while selecting. Use that same window for every arm and all five formal seeds.
